revised_prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: TripPet iOS achievement medal raster art candidate, later converted into a transparent 768x768 local candidate asset
Asset name: achievement_medal_steps_tier_003
Primary request: Create one premium collectible steps achievement medal for tier 3, WHITE rank, based on the Chinese title concept "佛山无影脚在世传人" (legendary shadowless kicking foot). The image itself must contain no text, no numbers, no labels.
Scene/backdrop: perfectly flat solid #ff00ff chroma-key background for background removal. The background must be one uniform #ff00ff color with no shadows, gradients, texture, reflections, floor plane, transparency checkerboard, or lighting variation.
Subject: exactly one centered circular collectible medal. Inside the circle is the same funny anthropomorphic foot mascot design: soft foot-shaped body, five toes on top like a goofy crown/hair tuft, tiny cartoon arms and tiny legs, expressive face. Tier 3 pose: dramatic martial-arts style kick with the foot mascot spinning, one tiny leg extended, multiple pale translucent motion afterimages of toes/footprints around it, confident silly face. No real person, no animal, no weapons.
Medal border: WHITE rank, pearl-white and silver-white only, most ornate of the first white group: circular raised rim, white enamel side wings, small silver studs, subtle white crown-like top ornament, but clearly not green/blue/purple/orange/gold.
Style/medium: same premium mobile game collectible style as the new TripPet travel medals: polished 3D-like enamel and metal, glossy highlights, cute humorous center character, crisp small-UI readability, not watercolor paper.
Composition/framing: exactly one centered medal, full object visible, generous padding, square composition, central mascot fully inside circular core. Same base circle size as tiers 1 and 2.
Lighting/mood: bright soft studio highlights, energetic and funny.
Color palette: pearl white and silver border, warm cream foot mascot, soft blush, pale gray-white motion swooshes; avoid #ff00ff anywhere in the subject.
Text: none.
Constraints: no letters, no numbers, no Chinese, no labels, no watermark, no cast shadow, no contact shadow, no reflection, do not create multiple medals, no shield shape, no dark UI card.
rank_color_rule: 001-003 white, 004-006 green; future 007-008 blue, 009-010 purple, 011-012 orange, 013-014 gold
transparent_background_method: built-in image_gen on #ff00ff chroma key, remove_chroma_key.py auto-key soft matte despill, resize to 768x768
